- [List a project's scenarios](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-a-projects-scenarios.md): The studies published
from this project — name, access mode, attached servers, and share link. Read-only.
- [Publish an environment for user testing](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/publish-an-environment-for-user-testing.
md): PUT, not POST, because publishing is IDEMPOTENT: one study per environment, and publishing an already-published environment r
eturns the existing one rather than minting a second. `created` says which happened.
- [Unpublish an environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/unpublish-an-environment.md): Takes the study down. Del
iberately NOT behind the beta gate that guards publishing: an organization that loses the flag must still be able to take a live s
tudy down.
- [Get a study](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/get-a-study.md): One study's full read: execution settings (model, s
ystem prompt, tool-approval policy, attached servers, share link), the environment it publishes, and the insights envelope over it
s latest analyzed window.
- [Update a scenario](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/update-a-scenario.md): Change a study's identity or its exposu
re — but not both in one call. **Send `mode` on its own.** Identity and exposure are separate operations upstream, and applying th
em in sequence could leave the study live in a mode you did not ask for.
- [List a scenario's sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-a-scenarios-sessions.md): What visitors did, as
summaries. Project members only — this route is deliberately absent from the guest allowlist, so a share-link visitor can never re
ad other visitors' sessions.
- [Get a session transcript](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/get-a-session-transcript.md): The projected transcript,
paged. Tool payloads and blobs are dropped, and the stored blob URL is never returned.
- [Set the guest-execution caps](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/set-the-guest-execution-caps.md): The spend dial fo
r anonymous visitors. A FULL REPLACEMENT — send every field. These caps only mean something as a set, and a partial update that ra
ised one while leaving another stale would produce a combination nobody chose.
- [Rotate the share link](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/rotate-the-share-link.md): Mints a new share link and stop
s the old URL from granting access. Everyone you shared it with needs the new one.
- [Invite a member](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/invite-a-member.md): Upsert by email, so re-inviting somebody is
not an error. Only meaningful while `mode` is `invited_only`.
- [Remove a member](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/remove-a-member.md): Removal NARROWS access, so it bumps `access
Version` and cuts off any session that member already had — it takes effect at once rather than at expiry.
- [Point a scenario at a different environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/point-a-scenario-at-a-different-envi
ronment.md): Keeps the study's LINK, its members and its session history while changing what visitors actually reach. The alternat
ive — unpublish and republish — mints a new link, which means re-sharing it with everyone.
- [Session metrics](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/session-metrics.md): Volumes, completion and feedback rates over
the study's sessions.
- [Usage breakdown](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/usage-breakdown.md): Which models, tools and servers the study's
sessions used.
- [Current window signals](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/current-window-signals.md): What the miner extracted from
the current window — and where you get the window id the insights read takes.
- [List scenario findings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-scenario-findings.md): Every finding raised over thi
s study's windows, dismissed ones included — dismissal is a state on the finding, not a deletion.
- [Read a window's insights](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/read-a-windows-insights.md): Poll this after requesting
a generation.
- [Request insights for the current window](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/request-insights-for-the-current-window.
md): **No credits are consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the study's current window and draws on the orga
nization's `insightsPerDay` ledger, which counts REQUESTS and is SHARED with eval-run and swarm run insights, so a request here ta
kes one from there.
- [Cancel a window's generation](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/cancel-a-windows-generation.md): Releases a generat
ion that is stuck `pending`. Idempotent against an already-finished one.
- [Dismiss a finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/dismiss-a-finding.md): Keyed on the finding's stable remediati
on id, so the same problem stays dismissed when insights regenerate. Bodyless: the path names the finding.
- [Restore a dismissed finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/restore-a-dismissed-finding.md): Undoes a dismissal.
Bodyless: the path names the finding.
- [Create (or revive) a relay tunnel for a named project server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/tunnels/create-or-revive-a-
relay-tunnel-for-a-named-project-server.md): Registers a server record named `name` if missing, mints a relay tunnel grant for it,
and **persists the tunnel bearer URL (including the plaintext `?k=` secret) onto the server record's `url`** so evals and studies
can target the tunnel like any remote server. The plaintext persistence is a deliber…
- [Revoke a tunnel's live grant](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/tunnels/revoke-a-tunnels-live-grant.md): Revokes the grant
at the control plane and edge: the public URL stops working imme
